Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's first passing course (eight volumes), from early in his ADCC career. Volume 1 covers opening closed guard and rubber guard, and establishing an inside foot. Volume 2 covers the split squat (dealing with the lasso, back stepping into leg attacks or a guillotine) and passing the low knee shield. Volume 3 covers shutting down the underhook, body lock and under-over passing (with a kneebar option). Volume 4 covers half butterfly passing using the split squat. Volume 5 covers passing off the inside foot against De La Riva and the side body lock on a seated opponent. Volume 6 covers over-under and double-over body lock passing and butterfly. Volume 7 covers drills (Eliot Marshall drills, toreando, body lock cartwheel). Volume 8 is rolling commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi passers; the foundation for his 2.0 and 3.0 courses.

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's updated passing system ('the real way to pass good guards'), eight volumes. Volume 1 sets out the new passing philosophy. Volume 2 covers the toreando to side control and to knee on belly. Volume 3 covers the grip battle at the knee and passing on the grip strip. Volume 4 covers high step passing and the toreando / high step dilemma. Volume 5 covers 'rebooting the system' when the partner grabs the legs. Volume 6 covers opponents who re-guard immediately, and high stepping against outside De La Riva. Volumes 7 and 8 are rolls with commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi passers facing good open guard players.
key: Toreando to side control and knee on belly
Dealing with leg grabs and re-guards

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's deep dive on the body lock pass, ten volumes. Volume 1 covers the types of body lock. Volume 2 covers inside versus outside knee and entering a basic front body lock. Volume 3 covers passing without exposing your knees, using near- and far-side tight waists. Volume 4 covers high tripod body locks (low hip versus high hip). Volume 5 covers pummelling a leg back inside, and top pummelling. Volume 6 covers over-under body locks. Volume 7 covers side body locks. Volume 8 covers head-outside body lock passing. Volumes 9 and 10 are rolls with commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi passers who want the body lock as their main pass.
key: Over-under, side and head-outside body locks
